facts.text: Tower's rooms and suites have warm wood accents and views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
facts.excerpt: featuring artful touches, warm wood accents, and stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean and South Florida coastline

facts.text: Built-in window seating in Tower's rooms emphasizes the views, with warm wood accents and Floridian-inspired artwork.
facts.excerpt: Built-in window seating emphasizes the spectacular views, while warm wood accents and Floridian-inspired artwork evoke a breezy, casual luxury.

facts.text: Tower was designed by Rockwell Group, with a coastal theme, custom palm leaf-inspired carpets and warm wood accents.
facts.excerpt: The Tower was designed by Rockwell Group, and the all-suite rooms feature a coastal theme, complete with custom palm leaf-inspired carpets and warm wood accents.

facts.text: Tower's all-suite floors can be configured to guests' needs, from grouping connecting suites to taking over an entire floor, for groups and families.
facts.excerpt: Whether grouping connecting suites or taking over the entire floor, Tower offers completely customizable stays that are ideal for groups and families.

facts.text: Tower is steps away from Harborside's restaurants and Harborside Pool Club.
facts.excerpt: as is Tower's ideal location, steps away from Harborside's many restaurants and Harborside Pool Club.

facts.text: Harborside Pool Club, just steps from Tower, has three pools, a lazy river, two water slides and cabanas with personal butler service.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from Tower, Harborside Pool Club brings endless possibilities with three pools, a 450-foot lazy river, two water slides, luxury cabanas with personal butler service

facts.text: The Tower lounge offers complimentary refreshments, coffee and pastries.
facts.excerpt: The exclusive Tower lounge offers complimentary refreshments, coffee & pastries

facts.text: Suite Collection guests have access to Top of the Tower, a private lounge on the 27th floor with views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
facts.excerpt: Gain entry to the newly reimagined Top of the Tower – a private lounge in a coveted setting on the 27th floor with sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and South Florida coastline

facts.text: Top of the Tower was once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay's first North American outpost.
facts.excerpt: Once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay’s first North American outpost, Top of the Tower has been reimagined as an exclusive 27th-floor lounge

facts.text: Top of the Tower has vintage artwork, curated Assouline books and classic telescopes.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate the spirit of travel with vintage artwork, curated Assouline books, and classic telescopes that bring the turquoise seascape into focus.

facts.text: Tower Suite Collection guests get a complimentary breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner bites, and drinks at Top of the Tower.
facts.excerpt: Access to Top of the Tower from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm with complimentary breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner bites, and drinks.

facts.text: Suite Collection guests at Tower get preferred seating at Beach Club's beach and pools and at Harborside Pool Club, plus priority dining reservations.
facts.excerpt: Suite Collection guests receive benefits throughout the resort, from preferred seating at Beach Club’s beach and pools and at Harborside Pool Club to priority dining reservations

facts.text: Suite Collection guests have a dedicated floor butler team.
